newsitem.title: USA: Carolina Power sees Brunswick out a few days.
newsitem.headline: Carolina Power sees Brunswick out a few days.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 1,521 megawatt Brunswick nuclear facility is expected to be shut for several days for emergency system evaluations following the passing of Hurricane Fran, a spokesman said.

Although the plant's two reactors at Southport, N.C. were not damaged by the hurricane, the company will evaluate all emergency systems at the site before resuming production, spokesman Mac Harris said Friday.
The plant, on the North Carolina coast near where Fran hit land with 120 mph winds, was shut earlier Thursday in anticipation of the hurricane.

Although Harris would not give an exact restart date for the Brunswick plant, he said it took "three to three and a half days" to complete evaluations and restart the facility after the area was hit by Hurricane Bertha in July.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
